fonts.display: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Esbuild', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Obsidian Canvas
palette.role: Page background, dominant surface — near-black with a whisper of warmth, the default stage for all content

palette.name: Void
palette.role: Deepest surface layer for hero gradients, modal backdrops, and borders that need to disappear into the canvas

palette.name: Charcoal Card
palette.role: Elevated card and panel surfaces sitting one step above the canvas

palette.name: Slate Edge
palette.role: Hairline borders and dividers on dark surfaces

palette.name: Iron Veil
palette.role: Muted backgrounds for tags, list-item fills, and disabled state washes

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Icon strokes, secondary text, and inactive controls — the workhorse mid-gray

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Tertiary text and subtle body borders in content-heavy lists

palette.name: Frost
palette.role: Light-mode borders, input fields, and secondary CTA borders

palette.name: Linen
palette.role: Light-mode surface tint and subtle section dividers in white backgrounds

palette.name: Snow
palette.role: Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Electric Iris
palette.role: Primary action background, active nav indicator, hero aurora cool stop — vivid violet-blue against charcoal reads as switched-on, not corporate

palette.name: Ember Pulse
palette.role: Secondary accent, hero aurora warm stop, notification dot, illustration highlight — the amber that breaks the blue's composure and gives the beam its heat

palette.name: Molasses
palette.role: Deep ember tone for dark-context borders, icon strokes, and tag fills when coral would be too bright
